paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Bisna—in Af Al Pi, Bisa—father of R. Oshaya Rabbah, in Rabbi's days. After marrying he went to his teacher's house and stayed twelve years. When he returned, he did not recognize his household, and encountered his young son. Rami bar Chama applied to him, “The threefold cord, etc.” Tosafot writes that this applies when all three are alive and all are sages: Ketubot 62b. R. Yehudah ben Pazi, in his name. R. Yosi bar Chanina and R. Yaakov bar Acha, in his name: Sheviit, chapter 2, halakhah 2. R. Yaakov bar Idi and Rav Yitzchak bar Nachman gave him a dinar, and he gave it to the poor: end of Peah; Shekalim, chapter 5. R. Yishmael son of R. Yosi ben Chalafta said to him: Niddah 14b. He asked R. Yishmael son of R. Yosi: Jerusalem Niddah, beginning of chapter 2. R. Marinos came before him. He disagrees with Bar Kappara; it was asked whether Rabbi Oshaya heard from his father or Bar Kappara; see there. In Rav's name: Rabbah, beginning of Vayikra.
